The
planned/deferred RQ-H2K track may consume trace-completeness and lineage evidence only;

The current machine-readable gate is the Retry 5 post-run terminal execution-control

It blocks the consumed smoke, V6, and V7 identities and names no successor.

## T07 infrastructure update — design only

The Mac-local Docker Desktop and Colima/Lima paths are now terminal rejected
infrastructure alternatives. The project selected a short-lived x86_64 Lambda
On-Demand Cloud host as T07's planned substrate, with no persistent Lambda filesystem
and provider-API termination as the billing boundary.

This selection is not an experiment run or cloud authorization. The seven-GET
inventory later completed with schema-valid responses, no running instance, and a
hash-verified copy on the approved MacBook archive. Offline adjudication found that
the apparent duplicate images were regional availability rows, not conflicting image
identities. Six resource tuples satisfy the fixed policy at the observed price, but
none is selected.

The effective global firewall also contains non-SSH rules, and no regional/per-instance
ruleset exists. Such a ruleset would be additive, not a substitute for strict global
rules. A future gate must preserve the separate same-region ruleset requirement and
would also need fresh account-wide-zero evidence, an explicit workspace-dependency
attestation, an approved public IPv4 `/32`, a sealed original snapshot, provider
termination before verified restoration, and independent host-key trust. Because the sealed
inventory retained only account SSH-key names, it cannot prove which local public key
matches. The current state is therefore `inventory-evidence-insufficient`; host
qualification, the Playwright/SiRA image probes, the live reactive/simulative pair,
paid compute, model calls, browser actions, and interpretation all remain unauthorized.
The offline Gate L1.3 work made no account request, accessed no real secret or private
key, and did not mutate a cloud resource, use SSH, run a container or browser, call a
model, or execute either SiRA condition.

Gate L1.4 has since prepared an unauthorized minimum-disclosure follow-up: one future
read-only SSH-key listing, with a fresh durable request ledger and private/public
evidence separation plus a distinct post-ledger archive-finalization record, can
classify the existing account-key match without repeating
the broad inventory. The design supports standard public-key encodings and opens only
local `.pub` files; it does not expose key bodies, fingerprints, raw provider IDs, or
home paths publicly. The request has not run, no key is selected, and Gate L2 remains
blocked and unauthorized.

That minimum read later completed and established one unique account/local public-key
